title: Reference images come to Play
summary:
Reference images reached Play, nine community apps joined the directory, and text caching moved into Enter.

Play now accepts up to four reference-image URLs for models that support image input, with thumbnails for reviewing and removing them. API errors are also shown more clearly. A separate update addressed reference-image editing support for `gptimage-large`.

The app directory gained tools for aquarium care, vocabulary study, Indonesian-language chat, coursework, image-to-prompt workflows, logo and name generation, coloring books, and Persian-language image generation. PromptPi! stands out for turning images into prompts in batches.

The Flower-tier flow now applies subscription changes after qualifying PR merges or registration rechecks, and app submissions enter the same review path. Earlier dry runs are not corrected retroactively.

highlights.title: Reference images in Play
highlights.text: Add up to four image URLs when generating with a model that supports image input. Review the thumbnails, remove what you don't need, and generate. [Try Play](https://pollinations.ai/play).
